_notes: Curated real image URLs for Globie's Atlas. All primary candidates are Wikimedia Commons files referenced via the stable redirect endpoint https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/<URL-ENCODED EXACT FILENAME>?width=1280 (and ?width=900 for gallery), which resolves to the real image without needing the storage hash. Filenames were verified via web search of commons.wikimedia.org file pages (network byte-verification was not possible in this sandbox, so they were NOT loaded/checked pixel-by-pixel). Most filenames are high-usage, long-lived, well-known images and are marked 'high' confidence. Where a precise filename could not be pinned to a single confirmed file page (e.g. a specific husky or Tenerife Teide shot, Rovaniemi aurora, some Rabat souk / mint-tea / beach shots, Porto detail shots, and a couple of Istanbul detail shots), confidence is 'medium' or 'low' and a LoremFlickr fallback keyword string is supplied; the app should fall back to LoremFlickr on image error. Specific files I was less certain of: the exact husky/sled-dog still (only an .ogv video was clearly confirmed in Lapland), some generic 'colourful souk' / 'mint tea' / 'Atlantic beach' Rabat shots, and the Tenerife 'TEIDE.JPG' exact casing. Every slot still degrades gracefully to fallbackKeywords. Filenames confirmed on commons file pages include: Diamonds Thudufushi Beach and Water Villas May 2017 -09.jpg (featured), Kasbah des Oudaias P1060356.JPG, Hassan Tower and columns (Rabat, Morocco) (15126547404).jpg, Aurora borealis over Lapland (Unsplash).jpg, Athens Parthenon Acropolis.jpg, 1003 Acropolis of Lindos in Rhodes Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg, Ponte D Luis e ribeira do Porto.JPG, Istanbul panorama and skyline.jpg.
